label: Diagram 1.3
caption: Diagram 1.3 | WC access zones
description: The drawing is a plan view showing two examples of WC access zones, with a green banner at the bottom reading "Diagram 1.3" and "WC access zones". The left plan is captioned "Example 1.3A – Clear access for oblique transfer" and the right "Example 1.3A – Clear access for frontal transfer". Each plan shows a WC, drawn as an oval pan with a rectangular cistern, and a grey shaded access zone in front of it. In both, a vertical double-headed arrow labelled "750mm" spans the depth of the shaded zone. In the left plan a vertical label "Opening to front of WC" sits at the left, with a dimension "250mm" marking the gap at the opening; below the WC, horizontal dimensions read "450*mm" to the left of the centre line and "400mm" to the right. In the right plan the horizontal dimensions read "450*mm" on each side of the centre line. To the right a "Notes:" block states: 1. All dimensions minimum unless otherwise stated. 2. * denotes minimum but 500mm preferred. 3. Basins should not project into access zones in such a way as to impede access.
